capability_grants_service_drafts_only.name: capability_grants_service_drafts_only
capability_grants_service_drafts_only.value: "capability_grants"."service_name" is null or coalesce("capability_grants"."role" = 'ai_service', false) or coalesce("capability_grants"."capability" in ('ai.draft', 'translation.draft', 'message.draft'), false)

capability_grants_record_scope.name: capability_grants_record_scope
capability_grants_record_scope.value: ("capability_grants"."record_id" is null) or ("capability_grants"."record_type" is not null)

sessions_one_account.name: sessions_one_account
sessions_one_account.value:
("sessions"."account_kind" = 'staff' and "sessions"."staff_account_id" is not null and "sessions"."client_account_id" is null)
        or ("sessions"."account_kind" = 'client' and "sessions"."client_account_id" is not null and "sessions"."staff_account_id" is null)

approvals_human_decision.name: approvals_human_decision
approvals_human_decision.value: "approvals"."state" not in ('approved', 'rejected') or (coalesce("approvals"."decided_by_kind" in ('staff', 'client'), false) and "approvals"."decided_by_id" is not null and "approvals"."decided_at" is not null)

appointments_confirmed_slot.name: appointments_confirmed_slot
appointments_confirmed_slot.value: "appointments"."state" not in ('confirmed', 'reschedule_requested', 'completed', 'no_show') or ("appointments"."confirmed_starts_at" is not null and "appointments"."confirmed_ends_at" is not null)

document_versions_reviewed_by_human.name: document_versions_reviewed_by_human
document_versions_reviewed_by_human.value: "document_versions"."state" <> 'reviewed' or ("document_versions"."review_type" is not null and "document_versions"."reviewed_by_staff_id" is not null)

messages_sent_only_when_approved.name: messages_sent_only_when_approved
messages_sent_only_when_approved.value: "messages"."direction" = 'inbound' or "messages"."state" in ('draft') or ("messages"."approval_id" is not null and "messages"."approved_content_hash" is not null)

translations_approved_by_human.name: translations_approved_by_human
translations_approved_by_human.value: "translations"."state" <> 'approved' or ("translations"."reviewed_by_staff_id" is not null and "translations"."approval_id" is not null)

service_requests_waiting_dependency.name: service_requests_waiting_dependency
service_requests_waiting_dependency.value: "service_requests"."state" not in ('awaiting_access', 'awaiting_approval', 'awaiting_parts') or ("service_requests"."waiting_on" is not null and "service_requests"."follow_up_at" is not null)

service_requests_spending_approved.name: service_requests_spending_approved
service_requests_spending_approved.value: "service_requests"."state" not in ('scheduled', 'work_performed', 'awaiting_verification', 'resolved') or coalesce("service_requests"."estimated_cost_minor", 0) = 0 or "service_requests"."spending_approval_id" is not null

locale_settings_indexable_approved.name: locale_settings_indexable_approved
locale_settings_indexable_approved.value: not "locale_settings"."indexable" or ("locale_settings"."enabled" and "locale_settings"."indexable_approval_id" is not null)

cases_stage_matches_kind.name: cases_stage_matches_kind
cases_stage_matches_kind.value:
("cases"."kind" = 'buyer' and "cases"."stage" in ('needs_agreed', 'evaluating', 'viewing', 'proposal_preparation', 'proposal_active', 'coordination', 'completed', 'failed', 'on_hold', 'paused', 'closed'))
        or ("cases"."kind" = 'seller' and "cases"."stage" in ('request_received', 'scope_authority_confirmed', 'assessment', 'instructions_agreed', 'preparing', 'marketing', 'proposal_coordination', 'completion_handover', 'paused', 'closed'))
        or ("cases"."kind" = 'rental' and "cases"."stage" in ('requirements_agreed', 'viewing_arranged', 'application_review', 'terms_agreed', 'tenancy_agreement', 'handover', 'tenancy_started', 'application_declined', 'paused', 'closed'))

cases_disposition_reason.name: cases_disposition_reason
cases_disposition_reason.value: "cases"."stage" not in ('paused', 'closed') or ("cases"."disposition_reason" is not null and "cases"."outstanding_obligations" is not null)

inquiries_owned_after_received.name: inquiries_owned_after_received
inquiries_owned_after_received.value: "inquiries"."state" in ('received', 'suspected_duplicate', 'discarded') or "inquiries"."owner_staff_id" is not null or "inquiries"."coverage_queue" is not null

party_relationships_reviewed_authority.name: party_relationships_reviewed_authority
party_relationships_reviewed_authority.value: "party_relationships"."authority" <> 'reviewed' or ("party_relationships"."authority_reviewed_by_staff_id" is not null and "party_relationships"."authority_reviewed_at" is not null)

tasks_waiting_names_dependency.name: tasks_waiting_names_dependency
tasks_waiting_names_dependency.value: "tasks"."state" <> 'waiting' or ("tasks"."waiting_on" is not null and "tasks"."follow_up_at" is not null)

tasks_done_records_outcome.name: tasks_done_records_outcome
tasks_done_records_outcome.value: "tasks"."state" <> 'done' or ("tasks"."outcome_note" is not null and "tasks"."completed_at" is not null)
